WITH totals AS (
        SELECT SUM(s.revenue) FILTER (WHERE s.date >= $1) AS revenue,
        SUM(s.cogs) FILTER (WHERE s.date >= $1) AS cogs,
        SUM(s.revenue) FILTER (WHERE s.date < $1) AS prior_revenue,
        SUM(s.cogs) FILTER (WHERE s.date < $1) AS prior_cogs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date) FILTER (WHERE s.date >= $1) AS days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date) FILTER (WHERE s.date < $1) AS prior_days,
        MIN(s.date) FILTER (WHERE s.date >= $1) AS coverage_start,
        MAX(s.date) FILTER (WHERE s.date >= $1) AS coverage_end,
        ($2::date - $1::date) AS expected_current_days, ($1::date - $3::date) AS expected_prior_days
        FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $3 AND s.date < $2) SELECT t.revenue AS company_revenue, t.cogs AS company_cogs,
        t.revenue-t.cogs AS company_gross_profit,
        100*(t.revenue-t.cogs)/NULLIF(t.revenue,0) AS company_gross_margin_pct,
        CASE WHEN t.days = t.expected_current_days AND t.prior_days = t.expected_prior_days
        THEN 100*(t.revenue-t.prior_revenue)/NULLIF(t.prior_revenue,0) END AS company_revenue_change_pct,
        t.prior_revenue-t.prior_cogs AS prior_gross_profit,
        t.days = t.expected_current_days AND t.prior_days = t.expected_prior_days AS comparable,
        t.days <> t.expected_current_days AS partial_period,
        t.coverage_start, t.coverage_end, t.expected_current_days-t.days AS missing_or_unmatched_count,
        t.days AS current_days, t.prior_days AS prior_days,
        t.prior_revenue AS prior_revenue,
        t.expected_current_days, t.expected_prior_days, t.days AS source_count FROM totals AS t LIMIT 1
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT s.date ORDER BY s.date) AS dates FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 AND s.revenue IS NOT NULL AND s.cogs IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

WITH monthly AS (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date AS period, SUM(s.revenue) AS revenue,
        SUM(s.cogs) AS cogs, COUNT(DISTINCT s.date) AS days, MIN(s.date) AS coverage_start, MAX(s.date) AS coverage_end
        FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $3 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY 1),
        totals AS (SELECT c.period, c.revenue, c.cogs, p.revenue AS prior_revenue, p.cogs AS prior_cogs,
        c.days, COALESCE(p.days,0) AS prior_days, c.coverage_start, c.coverage_end,
        (c.period + INTERVAL '1 month')::date-c.period AS expected_current_days,
        c.period-(c.period - INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS expected_prior_days
        FROM monthly AS c LEFT JOIN monthly AS p ON p.period = (c.period - INTERVAL '1 month')::date
        WHERE c.period >= $1) SELECT t.period, t.revenue AS company_revenue, t.cogs AS company_cogs,
        t.revenue-t.cogs AS company_gross_profit,
        100*(t.revenue-t.cogs)/NULLIF(t.revenue,0) AS company_gross_margin_pct,
        CASE WHEN t.days = t.expected_current_days AND t.prior_days = t.expected_prior_days
        THEN 100*(t.revenue-t.prior_revenue)/NULLIF(t.prior_revenue,0) END AS company_revenue_change_pct,
        t.prior_revenue-t.prior_cogs AS prior_gross_profit,
        t.days = t.expected_current_days AND t.prior_days = t.expected_prior_days AS comparable,
        t.days <> t.expected_current_days AS partial_period,
        t.coverage_start, t.coverage_end, t.expected_current_days-t.days AS missing_or_unmatched_count,
        t.days AS current_days, t.prior_days AS prior_days,
        t.prior_revenue AS prior_revenue,
        t.expected_current_days, t.expected_prior_days, t.days AS source_count FROM totals AS t ORDER BY t.period LIMIT 200

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', s.date)::date AS period, SUM(s.revenue) AS company_revenue, SUM(s.revenue)-SUM(s.cogs) AS company_gross_profit FROM commerce.sales AS s WHERE s.date >= $1 AND s.date < $2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM commerce.orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered') AS delivered_line_revenue, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'),0) AS delivered_average_order_value, SUM(oi.discount_amount) AS promotion_discount, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS source_count FROM commerce.orders AS o LEFT JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 LIMIT 1

SELECT 'all' AS dimension, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price-oi.discount_amount) AS delivered_line_revenue FROM commerce.orders AS o LEFT JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS period, SUM(oi.discount_amount) AS promotion_discount FROM commerce.orders AS o LEFT JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= $1 AND o.order_date < $2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(w.sessions) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM commerce.web_traffic AS w WHERE w.date >= $1 AND w.date < $2 LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', w.date)::date AS period, SUM(w.sessions) AS sessions FROM commerce.web_traffic AS w WHERE w.date >= $1 AND w.date < $2 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
